caveats: Baseline pools for 1992-2002 use a +-5-calendar-day window, so values from 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05 enter the threshold/climatology (reported in baseline_analysed). Grid resolution is 0.02 deg, so analysed cells span 55.68-56.86 N, 16.46-17.64 E (all inside the requested bounds); 3310 of 3600 cells are sea cells (finite SST on every target day). Hot days use SST >= threshold; per-cell runs of >=5 hot days with 1-2-day gaps joined were detected only within the target period, as specified.
